_comment: llama.cpp server config. Copy to llama_cpp_config.json and update paths.

qwen3.6-27b-256k._comment: C3-256K: max context, q4_0 KV, no spec-dec. ~22 GB VRAM. No --cache-reuse (breaks hybrid DeltaNet state).

qwen3.6-27b-32k-specd._comment: C1-agg-32K: 32K ctx + Qwen3.5-4B spec-dec + vision. q4_0 KV keeps 32K KV in the same VRAM envelope 8K@q8_0 used. Mid-context multimodal default — survey/parse stages with image tokens + thinking budget exceed 8K, so this is the safer floor.
